title: Review sales exceptions
summary: Separate cancellations, missing customers and invalid values while retaining original records.
setup: Choose a retail CSV with InvoiceNo, CustomerID, Quantity, UnitPrice, StockCode, Description, InvoiceDate, Country and SourceRowID.
Choose a destination folder for the three review queues.
limitations: Queues overlap. A review flag is not a verified error or fraud finding.

title: Compare rental activity
summary: Join hourly activity with a daily calendar and export summary, Long and Wide reports.
setup: Choose hourly CSV: dteday, hr, casual, registered, cnt and weekday.
Choose daily CSV: dteday and weekday.
Choose output folders; inspect date coverage before running.
limitations: Missing hours stay missing. Reports are descriptive, not optimized staffing.

title: Build an hourly weather briefing
summary: Read an hourly NWS forecast and export the first 48 source periods.
setup: Review the public NWS hourly endpoint and location in Table Input.
Authorize network access and choose an output folder.
limitations: Requires Internet access. Forecast snapshots change; missing probabilities stay missing.

title: Explore customer purchase groups
summary: Aggregate recorded purchases, fit four clusters and inspect their profiles.
setup: Choose compatible retail CSV with customer, invoice, quantity and price fields.
Review the Columns and feature definitions for your data.
Choose assignments and model-export destinations.
limitations: Exploratory clusters can be dominated by outliers. These are not churn probabilities or validated business segments.

title: Train a document-routing model
summary: Build text features from labeled examples and inspect held-out routing predictions.
setup: Choose labeled complaint CSV matching the displayed input columns.
Review the text/label mapping and partition before training.
Choose validation-table and model-export destinations.
limitations: Historical balanced samples and near-duplicate text affect evaluation. Review every label and avoid sending sensitive text to an AI client.

title: Read printed documents
summary: Prepare images, extract text and keep document and region tables for review.
setup: Choose a folder of supported document images.
Select or download the compatible English OCR model pack in the app.
Choose document and region CSV output folders.
limitations: Resolution and aspect ratio matter. Review recognized text; this is not verified financial extraction.

title: Join regional holidays to planning dates
summary: Combine official regional holiday feeds with a planning-date table.
setup: Choose the planning CSV and review its date/region column mappings.
Review the three GOV.UK API sources and authorize network access.
Choose a report output folder.
limitations: Recorded matching was incomplete. Review unmatched dates; no complete holiday-coverage guarantee.
attribution: GOV.UK Bank Holidays · Open Government Licence

title: Explore rental-demand estimation
summary: Fit a regression model and compare held-out demand predictions.
setup: Choose the hourly rental CSV matching the displayed feature and count columns.
Review training/validation date boundaries and leakage-sensitive weather inputs.
Choose predictions and model-export destinations.
limitations: The recorded model underpredicted later demand. Observed weather is not a future forecast; practical forecast utility is unproven.

title: Reconcile two months of item sales
summary: Keep every source row, reconcile purchases and cancellations, and compare monthly item-code totals.
setup: Choose a CSV with exactly two calendar-month values and unique SourceRowID identifiers.
Match InvoiceNo, StockCode, Description, Quantity, InvoiceDate, UnitPrice, CustomerID and Country; InvoiceDate uses YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS and UnitPrice is GBP.
Choose one fresh folder for the row-disposition, monthly-total and item-comparison reports.
Apply the suggested Balanced working space for this larger workflow. Compact History avoids optional intermediate copies while keeping run summaries, live previews and your exported reports.
limitations: Recorded activity is not recognized revenue, profit or a matched-return ledger. The workflow derives earlier/later months; source completeness and currency remain your responsibility. Missing customers and zero prices are flagged; invalid numeric or sign-conflict rows stay in the disposition report.
